settings.title: HALLOWEEN SALE
settings.text: Order today. Dispatched in 1 to 3 business days with tracking emailed the moment it ships.

settings.text_1: “Wore it to our neighbours Halloween party and nobody could talk for a solid minute. The fan stands it up in about a minute and it stayed up all night. Your own legs are his legs so you can actually walk around, dance and get to the snack table in it.”
settings.text_2: “Four hours on one set of batteries and it never sagged. My hands were free the whole night so I could hold a drink and shake hands.”
settings.text_3: “Everything was in the box, fan, straps and instructions. Up on the kitchen floor in about a minute.”

settings.heading: How Does The Costume Work?
settings.content: You step into his legs, so your real legs are his legs, and the fan inflates the big suited body around you. Your head comes out of the little guy's collar and your hands come out of his sleeves, while his stuffed legs dangle in front. It looks like he is carrying you. You can walk, dance and sit down in it.

settings.heading: How Long Is Shipping?
settings.content: Orders are dispatched in 1 to 3 business days and delivery is 2 to 3 weeks from dispatch (please allow up to 30 days), with tracking emailed the moment it ships.

settings.heading: Will It Fit Me?
settings.content: One adult size fits roughly 5'3 to 6'4 (160 to 195 cm) and up to about 300 lb. The waist, ankle and wrist cuffs are elastic with adjustable straps, and the fan keeps it fully inflated whether you are 150 lb or 300 lb.

settings.heading: What's In The Box And How Does It Inflate?
settings.content: The costume, the battery fan unit with its on/off switch, adjustable straps and the instructions. Load 4 AA batteries (not included), zip in, flick the switch and it stands up in about 60 seconds. One set of batteries runs it for roughly 4 hours.

settings.text: Join our list for exclusive offers and first look at new drops.

settings.heading: Will it arrive in time for Halloween?
settings.row_content: Orders are dispatched in 1 to 3 business days and delivery is 2 to 3 weeks from dispatch, with tracking emailed the moment it ships. Orders placed now are expected to land in late October to early November, so order today for the best chance of having it for Halloween.

settings.heading: Can I actually move around in it?
settings.row_content: Yes. Your real legs are his legs, so you can walk, dance, sit down and get to the snack table. Your hands come out of the little guy's sleeves, so you can hold a drink.

settings.heading: How long do the batteries last?
settings.row_content: One set of 4 AA batteries (not included) runs the fan for roughly 4 hours. Bring a spare set for a long night.

settings.heading: What if it turns up damaged or the fan doesn't work?
settings.row_content: Send us a photo and we'll sort it out. You've got 30 days to return it for a refund, and if the fan or costume is faulty we'll replace it.

settings.title: "Wore it for four hours straight"
settings.text: “Wore it to the backyard Halloween party at ours. Your real hands are free so you can hold a drink and shake hands. Four hours on one set of batteries and it never sagged.”
settings.name: Travis M.
